title: Wopowog (Stony Brook)
summary: Wopowog is recorded for Stony Brook in Brookhaven town, with Wopawog appearing in earlier Long Island history writing.
history_content: The surviving entry identifies Stony Brook as the modern place associated with the name. The available text does not provide a fuller translation or context beyond the Stony Brook identification.
translation_content:
No secure translation is available in the reviewed source text. The meaning remains unresolved.

Why Place Names Matter

“Some songs or chants are a list of place names. They work as oral maps of an ancestor’s journey or a tribal boundary.”

— LEARNZ, Recording place names in events, songs, and chants (2025), Opening paragraph

Place-name history should show Native people as active and present, not only as names in old documents.
preservation_content: The history preserves the Wopowog/Wopawog name alongside modern Stony Brook while keeping the translation uncertainty visible.
whereintheworld_content: Approximate blue/general placement at Stony Brook in Brookhaven town. Coordinates are a modern anchor and not exact historic boundaries.
